title: Introduction to Wilderness Survival Clinic in Marin County
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult
policies: Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Learn the ancient skills of survival in the woods, including how to build a shelter, gather water, make a fire, and forage edible plants or set up traps for food. Both novice campers and seasoned backpackers will benefit from hands-on activities during this 5-hour class with a naturalist instructor. The session takes place in a redwood forest of Marin County, located north of San Francisco.
